footnote_text: The Issuer granted restricted stock units ("RSUs") to the Reporting Person. Each RSU represents the Reporting Person's right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock of the Issuer. The RSUs vest over three years, with one-third of the RSUs vesting on November 15, 2027, and one-sixth of the RSUs vesting semi-annually thereafter, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service as of each vesting date. || Includes 2,313,604 shares represented by RSUs and performance restricted stock units ("PSUs"). Each RSU/PSU represents the Reporting Person's right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock of the Issuer. The RSUs vest each quarter and the PSUs vest upon achievement of certain performance milestones, in both cases subject to the Reporting Person's continued service as of each vesting date.
